chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from al-Ḥajjāl, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, who said:
I saw Abū Jaʿfar and Abū ʿAbd Allāh, peace be upon them, that when they raised their heads from the second sajdah, they rose and did not sit.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam observed in this narration
key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbd Allāh, the Imam observed in this narration
key_terms.السَّجْدَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ: the second sajdah in the prayer cycle

ai.seo_question: Did Abū Jaʿfar and Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليهما السلام sit after the second sajdah before rising in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of Abū Jaʿfar and Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليهما السلام in salat (prayer). It indicates that after the second sajdah, they would rise directly without sitting, making it relevant to prayer rulings and the practical sunnah of the Imams عليهم السلام.
